targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, max(liquidity_limit)::BIGINT AS liquidity_limit
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND NOT is_unlimited
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Selected tickers: liquidity limit over the range

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND NOT is_unlimited
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  count(*) AS days,
  max(trad_dt) AS latest_dt,
  arg_min(liquidity_limit, trad_dt) AS first_limit,
  arg_max(liquidity_limit, trad_dt) AS latest_limit,
  min(liquidity_limit) AS min_limit,
  max(liquidity_limit) AS max_limit,
  (arg_max(liquidity_limit, trad_dt) / nullif(arg_min(liquidity_limit, trad_dt), 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS range_change
FROM d
GROUP BY ticker, instrument_id
ORDER BY ticker

panels.title: Largest limit changes vs previous day (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE NOT is_unlimited
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT c.ticker,
  c.instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  p.liquidity_limit AS prev_limit,
  c.liquidity_limit AS latest_limit,
  (c.liquidity_limit / nullif(p.liquidity_limit, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS limit_change
FROM cur c
JOIN prv p ON c.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
WHERE c.liquidity_limit <> p.liquidity_limit
ORDER BY abs(c.liquidity_limit / nullif(p.liquidity_limit, 0) - 1) DESC NULLS FIRST, c.ticker
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Largest liquidity limits (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE NOT is_unlimited
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  liquidity_limit
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY liquidity_limit DESC, ticker
LIMIT 50
